in_marathi.name: Partha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Son of Arjuna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Partha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Partha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'partha' which means 'Son of Arjuna'. Partha is an epithet for Arjuna, one of the greatest warriors in Hindu mythology, and is often referred to as Bhishma-partha or Arjuna-partha. Partha is also associated with the god Krishna, who is believed to have appeared before Arjuna in his divine form, and is known as Parthasarathi, or the charioteer of Arjuna.
